scorecard.rationale: Parkinson depression trials used mineral or corn oil comparators. The blood fatty-acid preprint measures circulating levels and cannot identify intake. Outside Parkinson, varied sunflower comparators lack an oil-free arm, and two newly indexed registrations have no posted mood results. The refined-oil weight-loss trial still lacks accessible arm-level depression data. Evidence leaves the effect of isolated oral refined sunflower oil on Parkinson depressive symptoms unresolved. The original Labrousse article places high-oleic sunflower oil in both combined diets and reports spatial memory. It provides no isolated refined oil and depression result.
